Less is more, as the lack of additional seasoning allows its natural taste to shine.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Whole Birds are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they can be made by burning a [[Raw Whole Bird]] with a [[Fire]] or [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} They can also be dropped by [[Black Hinox]]es when they are killed. After being roasted, the natural taste of Roasted Whole Birds have been brought out.
